limitations: Channel suffix is not sensor depth. Only explicitly supplied depth metadata can establish depth.
Physical values and flag-1 quality-passing counts are separate; unflagged or suspect data cannot establish validated depth observations.
Historical revisions and original receipt times not authenticated. Fixed investigated dates are not independent holdout.
No physical instrumentation, private records or production dependencies.
